readout_other: hippocampal LFP theta and gamma power, sample entropy, Lempel-Ziv complexity, theta-gamma phase-amplitude coupling
direction_notes: Absolute theta and gamma power rose with pressure while relative theta power fell; at 0.6-0.8 MPa trough-locked stimulation gave higher gamma absolute power, theta relative power and PAC than peak-locked stimulation.

exposures.label: closed-loop theta peak- or trough-locked TUS of CA1

timing.protocol_description: Closed-loop stimulation triggered at the peak or trough of the hippocampal theta rhythm; stimulation duration 100 ms, PRF 1 kHz, duty cycle 30% within the stimulation, stimulation interval 3 s.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Sixteen mice (C57BL/6, male, body weight: 20–25 g, Beijing Weitong Lihua Laboratory Animal Technology Co., Ltd., China) were used in this study.

flags.reason: Burst rule: DC 30% / PRF 1 kHz implies 0.3 ms pulses, so the 100 ms 'stimulation duration' is the train; pulse duration is not stated and was not computed.
Pressure swept from 0.05 to 0.8 MPa; the paper does not say whether this is free-field or through the skull (the field map is described as 'under the skull').
Auditory confounds are discussed citing earlier deaf-mouse work by the same group; no control was run in this study.
Only the 100 ms stimulation duration is given; total number of stimuli per animal is not stated.
